title: Binary Bubble Sort Inversions
statement: Given a binary array of length n and a binary string of the same length, each character selects one operation applied in order: a forward bubble-sort pass, sweeping left to right and swapping adjacent out-of-order pairs, or a reverse bubble pass sweeping right to left. The task is to report the number of inversions of the array before any operation and after each one, with n up to 5*10^5.
